Your Wellness Pass: 20% off one session

Choose the service you want it on, from IV therapy and injectables to laser, hormone care or medical weight loss. Single treatments are 20% off. On packages and multi-session courses, the discount comes off one session.

Choose your service, get your codeTakes about 30 seconds. One code per person. On packages and multi-session courses, 20% comes off one session. We never sell or share your information.
  • Free new patient consultation
  • Led by a board-certified nurse practitioner
  • Clear pricing before any treatment
Simple from start to finish

How your Wellness Pass works

1

Pick your service

Choose the service you want 20% off, then fill in the short form. It takes about 30 seconds.

2

Check your inbox

Your personal IHW20 code arrives by email within a few minutes.

3

Book your visit

Book online or call 972-891-8650, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM.

4

Save 20% at check-in

Show your code and tell us the email you used. We take 20% off one session of the service you chose.

What you save

20% off one session of the service you choose

Your code covers one session of the service you pick when you claim it. Here is what a few single-session favorites cost with the discount.

Who you will see

Care led by Lori Secerovic, APRN, FNP-C

Lori is a board-certified family nurse practitioner. Her background in high-acuity critical care at the University of Chicago shapes how every plan here starts: a real conversation about your goals, then clear next steps.

  • Free consultation for new patients
  • Exact pricing, with your 20% applied, before you commit
  • Every visit by appointment, so your time is respected

Our clinic at 8200 N MacArthur Blvd, Suite 100, Irving, TX 75063

Good to know

Wellness Pass questions

How do I use my code?

Book the service you chose, then show your code at check-in and tell us the email address you signed up with. We match both to our records and take 20% off one session of it.

Which services can I choose from?

Any service on our menu: IV therapy, vitamin injections, injectables, laser and skin treatments, hormone therapy, wellness coaching and medical weight loss programs. You pick one when you claim your code. Prescription treatments require a clinical evaluation first.

Can I use it on more than one service?

No. Each code covers the single service you selected when you claimed it.

What if my treatment needs several sessions?

The discount applies to one session. If you book a package or a multi-session course, we take 20% off a single session of it, not off the whole package.

Is this for new patients only?

No. New and existing patients can each claim one code.

Can I combine it with other offers?

No. One code per person, used once, and it cannot be combined with other promotions or sale pricing.

Is the first consultation free?

Yes. New patient consultations are free, with no deposit. You leave with a plan and exact pricing before you decide on anything.

Does the code expire?

There is no end date right now. The offer can change or end, and the current terms are always on this page.

I did not get my email. What now?

Check your Promotions and Spam folders first. If you sign up again with the same email, we resend the same code. Still nothing? Call us at 972-891-8650.

Your code is one short form away

Choose your service, claim your code, and book whenever it suits you.

Claim My 20% Codeor call 972-891-8650

Offer terms. 20% off one session of the service you select when you claim your code. Single-session treatments are discounted in full. On packages, multi-session courses and monthly programs, the discount applies to one session or one month, not to the whole package. One code per person, used once. Valid for new and existing patients. Cannot be combined with other promotions or sale pricing. Present your code at check-in with the email address used to claim it. Prescription treatments require a clinical evaluation, and eligibility is decided by our clinician. No cash value. Irving Health and Wellness Clinic may change or end this offer at any time. People in the lifestyle photos on this page are illustrations, not patients or staff.
